source: Esri World Imagery z18, sand classified per pixel by ribbingsforsbuild/detect-sand.mjs (2026-09-05) and reviewed by eye on the review crops; positions are pixel centroids through the exact tile->WGS84->EPSG:3006->local mapping (~0.31 m/px), so the residual error is the imagery's own orthorectification (a few metres) plus classification edges, not a reading error. Migration-only under the blocked Esri redistribution licence; no imagery is stored.

method.classifier: min(R,G,B) >= 132, max-min <= 75, R-B >= 30, G-R <= -6 — calibrated with --find on 19 known bunkers (sand reads rgb 183–214/170–193/136–161; the dry-grass mound at [533,-409] reads 166,162,127 with G-R -4 and is rejected on warmth; roofs fail on G>R or R-B<30)
method.components: 4-connected, >= 40 px; area 8–700 m²; within 75 m of a hole line or green; not inside water, buildings, parking, the yard or within 7 m of a road/track
method.review: 32 candidates on the played ground; 21 accepted as sand bunkers, 11 rejected (pale dry rough along the hole-4 tree clump, farmland east of the ditch, yard hardstanding and material piles, worn tee ground)
method.shape: ellipse from the pixel covariance: major/minor = 4 sigma, angle of the principal axis in the x/z plane
